1025.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. Internal and exterior annotation leaders route around the resolved axis text; mutable shoulders do not feed back into axis placement. Automatic strings stay in a near- backbone channel. 1140.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. Internal and exterior annotation leaders route around the resolved axis text; mutable shoulders do not feed back into axis placement. Automatic strings stay in a near- backbone channel. Origin/end strings take priority and remain visible; an automatic endpoint may use either readable side of its tick, with a bounded tangential gap up to 4 mm, to clear fixed feature exit rays. Unresolved endpoint clearance is reported as endpoint_unresolved. Overlap checking may hide ordinary intermediate text while keeping its tick, with hidden_near_backbone in diagnostics. Explicit axis.text.offset values and explicit scale breaks stay fixed. |

1255.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. Internal and exterior annotation leaders route around the resolved axis text; mutable shoulders do not feed back into axis placement. Automatic strings stay in a near- backbone channel. Origin/end strings take priority and remain visible; an automatic endpoint may use either readable side of its tick, with a bounded tangential gap up to 4 mm, to clear fixed feature exit rays. Unresolved endpoint clearance is reported as endpoint_unresolved. Overlap checking may hide ordinary intermediate text while keeping its tick, with hidden_near_backbone in diagnostics. Explicit axis.text.offset values and explicit scale breaks stay fixed. |

1370.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. Internal and exterior annotation leaders route around the resolved axis text; mutable shoulders do not feed back into axis placement. Automatic strings stay in a near- backbone channel. Origin/end strings take priority and remain visible; an automatic endpoint may use either readable side of its tick, with a bounded tangential gap up to 4 mm, to clear fixed feature exit rays. Unresolved endpoint clearance is reported as endpoint_unresolved. Overlap checking may hide ordinary intermediate text while keeping its tick, with hidden_near_backbone in diagnostics. Explicit axis.text.offset values and explicit scale breaks stay fixed. |

1485.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. Internal and exterior annotation leaders route around the resolved axis text; mutable shoulders do not feed back into axis placement. Automatic strings stay in a near- backbone channel. Origin/end strings take priority and remain visible; an automatic endpoint may use either readable side of its tick, with a bounded tangential gap up to 4 mm, to clear fixed feature exit rays. Unresolved endpoint clearance is reported as endpoint_unresolved. Overlap checking may hide ordinary intermediate text while keeping its tick, with hidden_near_backbone in diagnostics. Explicit axis.text.offset values and explicit scale breaks stay fixed. |
